requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3841-4549--52.description:
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Relic of Legends by tapping Grimgrin, adding an additional mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Torens triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

728-3249-5268-5553.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5268-5553.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it triggers, causing you to scry 1 and create a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

4871-5626-7824.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
The total mana value of the creature on the battlefield and the creature card in your graveyard is at most 6.
4871-5626-7824.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing a nontoken creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Bard.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.
4871-5626-7824.notes: If the combined mana value of the creatures is less than 6, this combo will net infinite energy counters.

475-1379-4017-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1379-4017-4186.description:
Gain life in any way.
Scurry Oak triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1619-3967-4605-5542-6148.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6148.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Seasoned Dungeoneer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Seasoned Dungeoneer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Seasoned Dungeoneer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Seasoned Dungeoneer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Seasoned Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Seasoned Dungeoneer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-3967-4605-5542-6148.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

2724-3217-7012.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Airbender Ascension. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2700-3698-6972.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Shikari's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Shikari from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
When Arcbound Shikari enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1479-2374-2841-6156.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2374-2841-6156.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Maja and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Maja trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Maja triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2510-4955-7070.notablePrerequisites: There is a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
2510-4955-7070.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Grafted Wargear ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Semblance Anvil.
Repeat.

2292-3845-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

856-2267-5776-6798.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1799-2034-5359-6005.description:
Activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and two Gnomes, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

2459-2538-3676-6193.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
2459-2538-3676-6193.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Soul of the Harvest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Soul of the Harvest trigger, causing you to return Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1244-4231-4415-5542.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
1244-4231-4415-5542.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {2}{W}.
Bygone Bishop triggers twice, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
When Stonecloaker enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger twice.
Resolve both of the first Stonecloaker ability's triggers, returning itself and another creature with mana value 1 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve both remaining triggers, exiling two cards from any graveyard.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding two mana of any color(s).
Cast the other creature by paying its mana cost.
Bygone Bishop triggers twice, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

413-3284-4550-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-3284-4550-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

678-2060-2606-4017-4050.description:
Cast Pelakka Wurm by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
When Pelakka Wurm enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain 7 life.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting seven +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {4}{G}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Pelakka Wurm, adding {G}.
When Pelakka Wurm dies, its second ability and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Pelakka Wurm trigger, causing you to reveal the top card of your library and put it into your graveyard if its a creature card, or draw a card otherwise.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Pelakka Wurm from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

328-4017-4499-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Workhorse.
Your devotion to black is at least three, or you have at least two opponents.
328-4017-4499-5296.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
When Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain that much life.
Workhorse triggers, putting at least three +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Workhorse three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
If your devotion to black is at least four, this combo nets infinite +1/+1 counters on Workhorse and colorless mana.

1812-2034-2599-5140.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ministrant of Obligation, adding {C}{C}.
When Ministrant of Obligation dies, its afterlife ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Spirits, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Ministrant of Obligation to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1379-1580-1785-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Soldevi Adnate.
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
1379-1580-1785-2178.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton, adding {B}{B}.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Soldevi Adnate triggers, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2348-3385.description:
Whenever a land enters the battlefield, it enters as a 2/2 creature due to Nature's Revolt.
Aether Flash triggers, dealing 2 damage to the land.
The land dies as a state-based action due to having less than zero toughness.

1298-2034-2450-5195.description:
Cast Whim of Volrath with buyback by paying {2}{U}, targeting Ovika.
Ovika and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Ovika trigger, creating a 1/1 Phyrexian Goblin creature token.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath, returning it to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Phyrexian Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

1687-3018-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1687-3018-4050.description:
Cast Rancor by paying {G}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
Siona triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Rancor attached, adding {G}.
Rancor triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

678-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites: Coretapper does not have summoning sickness.
678-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it.
When Coretapper dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve Coretapper's ability, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Coretapper by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.

1912-2933-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 colorless Eldrazi Scion tokens.
Activate Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
